title: Conditioned
summary: CONDITIONED, participle passive 1. Stipulated; containing terms to be performed. 2. adjective Having a certain state or qualities. This word is usually preceded by some qualifying term; as good-condit

inlines.v: CONDITIONED, participle passive 1. Stipulated; containing terms to be performed. 2. adjective Having a certain state or qualities. This word is usually preceded by some qualifying term; as good-conditioned; ill-conditioned; best-conditioned.
